source.quote: SMSL's own page for the DO200 Pro, read 2026-11-27 with curl, « Introduction » bullets: « Using 12 pieces of Cirrus Logic's latest audio decoding chip CS43131 and carefully designed circuits, its performance reaches an unprecedented level of 0.00006 (-123dB) non-weighting distortion; »; « The brand-new third-generation XMOS XU-316, supports PCM up to 32bit/768kHz and DSD up to DSD256; »; « There are two modes to choose from: USB 1.1 and USB 2.0; »; « Bluetooth 5.1 digital audio input, external antenna, longer transmission distance; »

facts.chip: Twelve Cirrus Logic CS43131 (« Using 12 pieces of Cirrus Logic's latest audio decoding chip CS43131 »), XMOS XU-316 on USB.

_the_ceiling_is_the_XMOS_bullet: The rate and DSD ceilings come from the bullet naming the XMOS USB receiver, so they are written on usb only. No other input is given a PCM rate: the page states none.
_USB_1_1_mode_lowers_the_ceiling: « There are two modes to choose from: USB 1.1 and USB 2.0 ». The 768 kHz ceiling is the USB 2.0 figure; USB Audio Class 1 typically stops at 96 kHz, and the page gives no figure for the 1.1 mode. A device left in USB 1.1 mode will not reach the ceiling recorded here.
